title: Wyoming Legion Baseball Standings on July 29, 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By David Settle ,
8 hours ago
Wyoming American Legion Baseball teams have completed the regular season and Division 1 State Tournament. The Cheyenne Sixers topped the Sheridan Jets in the championship game of the D1 state tourney, 8-1. In the process, the Sixers became the only team to surpass 50 wins in the 2026 season. Meanwhile, some teams in the Division 2 State Tournament tried to stay sharp with extra regular-season, state tune-up games.
2026 WYOMING AMERICAN LEGION BASEBALL STANDINGS UPDATE The teams going to the Division 2 State Tournament from the South Conference are the Torrington Tigers, Wheatland Lobos, Cheyenne Eagles, and Green River Knights (host). The Jackson Giants, Cody Cubs, Lovell Mustangs, and Riverton Raiders represent the North. The tournament is in Green River from July 30 through August 3.
The Cheyenne Sixers advance to the Region 7 tournament in Medford, Oregon, on August 5 through August 9. The Sheridan Jets will join the host, Casper Wildcatters, at the Northwest Class A Regional Tournament (NWCART) in Casper on August 6 through August 10, at Mike Lansing Field.
Here are the standings after the conclusion of the regular season and the Division 1 State Tournament. Teams are listed by their conference record first.
